title.zh: 用一致的图层语法，呈现序列与关系。
title.en: Sequence plots built with consistent layer grammar.

description.zh: 比较多条序列、标注环形基因组、查看序列比对，并把独立视图组合成一张图。
description.en: Compare sequences, annotate circular genomes, inspect alignments, and connect independent views in one figure.

description.zh: 复用数据与图层，从不同角度查看同一组关系。
description.en: Reuse data and layers to inspect relationships from different perspectives.

description.zh: 从统一设置到按序列、按链配置，逐步调整局部效果。
description.en: Refine shared settings into local changes by sequence or strand.

description.zh: 连接独立面板，并按目标尺寸预览和保存。
description.en: Connect independent panels, then preview and save at the intended size.

purpose.zh: 比较基因组或基因簇，查看注释位置与区间之间的连接。
purpose.en: Compare genomes or gene clusters through annotations and interval relationships.

purpose.zh: 沿一条环形序列组织特征、名称与定量轨道。
purpose.en: Organize features, labels and quantitative tracks around one circular sequence.

purpose.zh: 在两条坐标轴上查看序列比对区段、方向与一致性。
purpose.en: Inspect aligned intervals, direction and identity on two sequence axes.

purpose.zh: 组合弦图、共线性图、径向视图和局部细节，用真实区间连接独立面板。
purpose.en: Combine Chord, Collinear, radial and detailed views, connecting independent panels through real intervals.
